name: THE MIRROR — Vessel & Body Tracking
objective: Implement MediaPipe body tracking, Gaussian Splat vessel rendering, head-tilt navigation, and the complete onboarding Descent/Calibration sequence.

tasks.title: Set up MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation (Model 1 Landscape, WASM)
tasks.deliverable: MediaPipe Selfie Segmentation module initialized and producing binary masks from webcam frames via WASM runtime.
tasks.acceptance: Segmentation model loads within 3 seconds and outputs a valid binary mask for a single webcam frame without errors.

tasks.title: Set up MediaPipe Face Mesh with 468 landmark detection
tasks.deliverable: MediaPipe Face Mesh module initialized and returning 468 facial landmark coordinates per detected face.
tasks.acceptance: Face Mesh returns a 468-element landmark array with x/y/z coordinates for a single face within 50ms per frame.

tasks.title: Set up MediaPipe Hand Landmarker with 21 landmarks per hand
tasks.deliverable: MediaPipe Hand Landmarker module initialized and returning 21 landmark positions per detected hand.
tasks.acceptance: Hand Landmarker detects at least one hand and returns 21 landmarks with confidence scores above 0.7 within 40ms per frame.

tasks.title: Implement webcam capture at 30fps using getUserMedia API
tasks.deliverable: Webcam capture module that acquires video stream at 30fps and delivers frames to processing pipeline.
tasks.acceptance: getUserMedia successfully opens a 640x480 video stream at 30fps and delivers frames to a callback without dropped frames for 10 seconds.

tasks.title: Create dedicated Web Worker for all MediaPipe processing
tasks.deliverable: Web Worker that receives webcam frames via transferable objects and returns segmentation masks plus face/hand landmarks off main thread.
tasks.acceptance: MediaPipe processing runs entirely in a Web Worker with zero main-thread blocking and round-trip latency under 33ms at 30fps.

tasks.title: Build segmentation mask processing pipeline (raw mask to refined mask per frame)
tasks.deliverable: Pipeline that takes raw MediaPipe segmentation output and produces a refined, temporally-stable mask suitable for vessel rendering.
tasks.acceptance: Refined mask output shows no flickering artifacts across 30 consecutive frames and maintains consistent body outline boundaries.

tasks.title: Implement smoothstep edge blur shader on segmentation mask (prevent cardboard cutout)
tasks.deliverable: Fragment shader that applies smoothstep-based edge blur to the segmentation mask boundary, creating organic falloff rather than hard edges.
tasks.acceptance: Vessel edges show a smooth 4-8 pixel gradient falloff with no visible hard-cut boundary when rendered at 1080p.

tasks.title: Create SparkJS Dynamic Cloud for vessel rendering (map webcam pixels to 3D splats)
tasks.deliverable: SparkJS-based dynamic Gaussian Splat cloud that maps masked webcam pixel data onto 3D splat positions forming the user vessel.
tasks.acceptance: Vessel renders as a coherent 3D splat cloud matching the user silhouette at 60fps with at least 5000 active splats.

tasks.title: Implement pixel-to-3D-space mapping on curved plane for splat positioning
tasks.deliverable: Mapping function that projects 2D webcam pixel coordinates onto a curved 3D surface to give the vessel depth and volumetric presence.
tasks.acceptance: Splats are distributed across a curved surface with visible parallax when the camera orbits, producing a non-flat vessel silhouette.

tasks.title: Build vessel color grading system (Deep Ink #1A1A2E baseline to Aged Gold #B8860B at peak coherence)
tasks.deliverable: Shader uniform-driven color grading system that interpolates vessel splat colors between Deep Ink and Aged Gold based on coherence value.
tasks.acceptance: Setting coherence to 0.0 renders vessel in #1A1A2E and setting to 1.0 renders in #B8860B with smooth gradient at intermediate values.

tasks.title: Implement breathing expansion effect (splat scale = 1.0 + lqd * baseScale)
tasks.deliverable: Vessel breathing animation that scales splats based on LQD bio-signal, creating a visible inhale/exhale rhythmic expansion.
tasks.acceptance: Vessel visibly expands by 5-15% during simulated inhale phase and contracts during exhale at a rate matching the LQD input frequency.

tasks.title: Calculate head-tilt vector from Face Mesh (nose tip vs ear/chin plane normal)
tasks.deliverable: Function that computes a 3D tilt vector from Face Mesh landmarks by comparing nose tip position against the ear-chin reference plane.
tasks.acceptance: Head-tilt vector accurately distinguishes left tilt, right tilt, forward lean, and backward lean with angular precision within 5 degrees.

tasks.title: Map head-tilt vectors to Rapier forces: left/right=steering torque, forward=move force, back=brake
tasks.deliverable: Physics integration that translates head-tilt vectors into Rapier rigid body forces for steering, forward motion, and braking.
tasks.acceptance: Tilting head left applies counter-clockwise torque, right applies clockwise, forward applies forward impulse, and backward reduces velocity to zero within 1 second.

tasks.title: Implement posture detection (upright=good nav, slouch=camera drift downward)
tasks.deliverable: Posture classification function that detects upright vs slouched position and outputs a normalized posture quality score.
tasks.acceptance: Upright posture returns score above 0.8 and slouched posture returns score below 0.4 with transition detection within 500ms.

tasks.title: Build LinearDamping viscosity system: high coherence=0.5 (fluid), low coherence=5.0 (sluggish)
tasks.deliverable: Dynamic linear damping system on the vessel Rapier body that adjusts movement viscosity based on real-time coherence signal.
tasks.acceptance: At coherence 1.0 vessel moves fluidly with damping 0.5 and at coherence 0.0 vessel feels sluggish with damping 5.0, with smooth interpolation between.

tasks.title: Create mock PIP data generator with adjustable coherence, LQD, entropy, breath phase
tasks.deliverable: Mock bio-signal generator that produces realistic PIP-format data streams with configurable coherence, LQD, entropy, and breath phase values.
tasks.acceptance: Mock generator outputs valid PIP data at 10Hz with all four parameters independently adjustable via debug controls between 0.0 and 1.0.

tasks.title: Define vessel state schema: vessel_id, transform, bio_state, visual_config as TypeScript types
tasks.deliverable: TypeScript type definitions and Zod schemas for complete vessel state including identity, transform, bio-signal state, and visual configuration.
tasks.acceptance: All vessel state types compile without errors and Zod validation correctly rejects malformed vessel state objects.

tasks.title: Implement privacy enforcement: all segmentation browser-local, no video to server
tasks.deliverable: Privacy audit confirming that all webcam data and segmentation processing remains client-side with no network transmission of video frames.
tasks.acceptance: Network tab inspection during 60 seconds of webcam usage shows zero outbound requests containing video or image data.

tasks.title: Build webcam permission flow with getUserMedia grant/deny detection
tasks.deliverable: Permission handling module that detects webcam grant, deny, and dismiss states and routes to appropriate Path A or Path B flows.
tasks.acceptance: Granting permission triggers Path A webcam vessel flow and denying permission triggers Path B geometric fallback within 500ms of user action.

tasks.title: Implement Path B geometric fallback: icosahedron vessel on webcam denied
tasks.deliverable: Geometric icosahedron vessel that serves as the fallback representation when webcam access is denied.
tasks.acceptance: On webcam denial, an icosahedron vessel spawns at origin within 200ms with correct Deep Ink coloring and visible wireframe edges.

tasks.title: Build Path B mouse/keyboard navigation controls (click-drag rotate, WASD move, scroll zoom)
tasks.deliverable: Traditional mouse and keyboard control scheme for Path B users including rotation, WASD movement, and scroll-based zoom.
tasks.acceptance: WASD keys move vessel in cardinal directions, mouse drag rotates view, and scroll wheel adjusts zoom between 0.5x and 3.0x without jitter.

tasks.title: Synchronize vessel visual position with Rapier physics body
tasks.deliverable: Synchronization layer that copies Rapier physics body position and rotation to the vessel visual representation each frame.
tasks.acceptance: Vessel visual mesh tracks physics body position with less than 1 pixel of visible lag at 60fps during continuous movement.

tasks.title: Implement splat transparency at body edges (alpha=0.5 at segmentation boundary)
tasks.deliverable: Shader that fades splat alpha to 0.5 at the segmentation mask boundary, creating a ghostly dissolve at vessel edges.
tasks.acceptance: Splats at the vessel boundary render at 50% opacity while core splats render at full opacity with smooth gradient between.

tasks.title: Build vessel turbulence parameter (entropy-driven splat position noise)
tasks.deliverable: Turbulence system that displaces splat positions based on entropy value, creating visible agitation at high entropy.
tasks.acceptance: At entropy 0.0 splats remain stable and at entropy 1.0 splats visibly jitter with 2-5 pixel displacement noise per frame.

tasks.title: Implement bilateral filter on segmentation mask for edge noise reduction
tasks.deliverable: GPU bilateral filter pass applied to segmentation mask that preserves edges while removing per-pixel noise.
tasks.acceptance: Filtered mask shows less than 2% pixel-level noise compared to raw mask while maintaining edge sharpness within 1 pixel tolerance.

tasks.title: Set vessel spawn position at origin (0, 1.7, 0) facing North (0,0,-50)
tasks.deliverable: Vessel initial spawn configuration that places the vessel at coordinates (0, 1.7, 0) oriented toward the North zone.
tasks.acceptance: Vessel spawns at exactly (0, 1.7, 0) with forward vector pointing toward (0, 0, -50) verified by debug overlay position readout.

tasks.title: Build vessel movement speed curve (acceleration ramp 0.5s, max velocity 8 units/sec)
tasks.deliverable: Movement speed controller with 0.5-second acceleration ramp and hard-capped maximum velocity of 8 units per second.
tasks.acceptance: Vessel reaches max velocity of 8 u/s after exactly 0.5 seconds of continuous forward tilt and never exceeds that cap.

tasks.title: Implement vessel rotation damping (prevent endless spinning from head-tilt)
tasks.deliverable: Angular damping on the vessel physics body that brings rotation to zero within 0.3 seconds of neutral head position.
tasks.acceptance: After head returns to neutral from 30-degree tilt, vessel rotation decays to below 0.01 rad/s within 300ms.

tasks.title: Build multi-face rejection (process only primary/largest face from Face Mesh)
tasks.deliverable: Face selection filter that identifies the largest detected face by bounding box area and discards all other face detections.
tasks.acceptance: When two faces are visible, only the face with the larger bounding box area is processed and the secondary face data is discarded.

tasks.title: Configure vessel physics body: mass=1.0, locked X/Z rotation (yaw only)
tasks.deliverable: Rapier rigid body configuration for the vessel with mass 1.0 and rotation locked to Y-axis (yaw) only.
tasks.acceptance: Vessel physics body has mass 1.0 and applying torque only produces Y-axis rotation with X and Z axes remaining locked at zero.

tasks.title: Create hand tracking skeleton debug visualization (21 landmarks visible in debug)
tasks.deliverable: Debug overlay that renders hand tracking skeleton with all 21 landmark points and connecting bones visible on screen.
tasks.acceptance: When debug mode is enabled, all 21 hand landmarks render as colored dots with bone connections matching the MediaPipe hand topology.

tasks.title: Implement MediaPipe warmup (discard first 10 frames to prevent jitter)
tasks.deliverable: Warmup gate that discards the first 10 MediaPipe inference frames before delivering results to the vessel pipeline.
tasks.acceptance: First 10 frames from MediaPipe are silently discarded and frame 11 is the first frame passed to downstream consumers.

tasks.title: Build vessel color transition smoothing (lerp color changes over 500ms, not snap)
tasks.deliverable: Color interpolation system that smoothly lerps vessel color changes over 500ms to prevent jarring visual snaps.
tasks.acceptance: Abruptly changing coherence from 0.0 to 1.0 produces a visible 500ms color transition with no single-frame color jumps.

tasks.title: Create webcam frame rate monitor (detect camera dropping below 25fps)
tasks.deliverable: Frame rate monitoring module that measures webcam delivery rate and fires a warning event when rate drops below 25fps.
tasks.acceptance: Monitor correctly detects when webcam drops below 25fps within 1 second and emits a low-fps warning event.

tasks.title: Implement webcam horizontal mirror mode for natural self-viewing
tasks.deliverable: Horizontal flip transform applied to webcam feed before splat mapping so the vessel mirrors the user like a reflection.
tasks.acceptance: User raising their right hand sees the vessel right hand raise on the corresponding side of the screen (mirror behavior).

tasks.title: Build vessel Zustand slice: position, rotation, bioState, visualConfig, isCalibrated
tasks.deliverable: Zustand store slice containing all vessel runtime state including position, rotation, bio-signal state, visual config, and calibration flag.
tasks.acceptance: Zustand vessel slice correctly stores and retrieves all five state properties with proper TypeScript typing and selector memoization.

tasks.title: Create vessel rendering toggle (splat cloud vs geometric based on webcam status)
tasks.deliverable: Conditional rendering component that switches between splat cloud vessel (Path A) and geometric vessel (Path B) based on webcam availability.
tasks.acceptance: Component renders splat cloud when webcam is active and icosahedron when webcam is denied, with toggle taking less than 100ms.

tasks.title: Implement face mesh landmark confidence filtering (reject frames below 0.8 confidence)
tasks.deliverable: Confidence gate that filters out Face Mesh frames with overall detection confidence below 0.8 threshold.
tasks.acceptance: Frames with detection confidence below 0.8 are rejected and the previous valid frame data is retained instead.

tasks.title: Build head-tilt deadzone (small movements below 3 degrees ignored for stability)
tasks.deliverable: Deadzone filter on head-tilt input that ignores angular changes below 3 degrees to prevent micro-drift navigation noise.
tasks.acceptance: Head movements under 3 degrees in any axis produce zero physics force output while movements above 3 degrees apply proportional force.

tasks.title: Create vessel bounding box for collision detection (capsule collider around splat cloud)
tasks.deliverable: Rapier capsule collider sized to encompass the vessel splat cloud for physics collision detection with environment.
tasks.acceptance: Capsule collider fully encloses the vessel splat cloud and correctly reports collision events when contacting scene geometry.

tasks.title: Implement background segmentation quality selector (fast/balanced/quality presets)
tasks.deliverable: Quality preset selector that configures MediaPipe segmentation model parameters for fast, balanced, or high-quality processing modes.
tasks.acceptance: Fast mode runs under 15ms per frame, balanced under 25ms, and quality under 40ms with visibly better edge quality at each tier.

tasks.title: Build webcam initialization error handler (camera in use, not found, not supported)
tasks.deliverable: Error handling module that catches and classifies all getUserMedia failure modes and routes to appropriate fallback paths.
tasks.acceptance: NotFoundError, NotAllowedError, NotReadableError, and OverconstrainedError are all caught and route to Path B with distinct internal error codes.

tasks.title: Create segmentation mask texture upload to GPU (efficient transfer via TexSubImage2D)
tasks.deliverable: Optimized GPU texture upload path that transfers segmentation mask data using texSubImage2D for minimal CPU-GPU transfer overhead.
tasks.acceptance: Mask texture upload completes in under 2ms per frame using texSubImage2D with no visible frame stutter during continuous upload.

tasks.title: Implement vessel LOD: full splat cloud under 15u, reduced under 30u, point light over 30u
tasks.deliverable: Level-of-detail system for the vessel that reduces splat count at medium distance and replaces with a point light at far distance.
tasks.acceptance: Vessel renders full splat cloud within 15 units, 50% splat count between 15-30 units, and a single point light beyond 30 units.

tasks.title: Build MediaPipe model loading progress indicator (percent loaded before first frame)
tasks.deliverable: Progress tracking module that reports combined loading percentage across all three MediaPipe models during initialization.
tasks.acceptance: Progress value increments from 0 to 100 as models load and reaches 100 exactly when all three models are ready for inference.

tasks.title: Create vessel interaction raycast system (detect when vessel approaches objects)
tasks.deliverable: Rapier raycast system that projects rays from the vessel in movement direction to detect approaching objects and trigger proximity events.
tasks.acceptance: Raycasts detect objects within 10 units ahead of vessel movement direction and fire proximity events with distance and object identity.

tasks.title: Implement vessel light emission (point light attached to vessel, Gold color, intensity from LQD)
tasks.deliverable: Point light component attached to vessel position with Aged Gold color and intensity dynamically driven by LQD signal value.
tasks.acceptance: Point light renders at vessel position with color #B8860B and intensity scaling linearly from 0.1 at LQD 0.0 to 2.0 at LQD 1.0.

tasks.title: Build MediaPipe worker performance counter (processing time per frame in debug)
tasks.deliverable: Performance counter in debug overlay showing per-frame MediaPipe processing time, average, and 99th percentile latency.
tasks.acceptance: Debug overlay displays current frame time, rolling 60-frame average, and p99 latency with values updating every frame.

tasks.title: Create comprehensive vessel rendering test: webcam to splat cloud at 60fps with color grading
tasks.deliverable: End-to-end integration test verifying the complete webcam-to-vessel pipeline including segmentation, splat rendering, and color grading at 60fps.
tasks.acceptance: Test confirms vessel renders at 60fps for 30 seconds with correct color grading response to coherence changes and visible breathing effect.

tasks.title: Build vessel state persistence (save vessel config to Zustand plus localStorage on change)
tasks.deliverable: Persistence layer that automatically saves vessel configuration to localStorage whenever Zustand vessel state changes.
tasks.acceptance: After modifying vessel config and refreshing the page, the vessel configuration is restored from localStorage matching the pre-refresh state.

tasks.title: Create Descent overlay component (full-screen, React portal, CSS transitions)
tasks.deliverable: Full-screen React portal overlay component with CSS transition support for the onboarding Descent sequence.
tasks.acceptance: Overlay renders at 100vw/100vh via React portal above all other content with opacity transitions completing in specified durations.

tasks.title: Implement T+0ms: Pure black overlay (opacity 1.0, no content)
tasks.deliverable: Initial Descent state rendering a pure black (#000000) overlay at full opacity with no visible content.
tasks.acceptance: At T+0ms the screen is completely black with opacity 1.0 and zero visible elements confirmed by screenshot comparison.

tasks.title: Implement T+1000ms: Deep Ink (#1A1A2E) fade-in with grain shader activating
tasks.deliverable: Timed transition at T+1000ms that fades overlay from black to Deep Ink color while activating the film grain post-processing shader.
tasks.acceptance: At exactly T+1000ms the overlay begins transitioning to #1A1A2E and film grain becomes visible within 200ms of transition start.

tasks.title: Implement T+2000ms: First particle (Bone white #F5F0E8 point light fades in at center)
tasks.deliverable: Single Bone white point light that fades in at viewport center at T+2000ms as the first visible element in the Descent.
tasks.acceptance: At T+2000ms a point light with color #F5F0E8 appears at screen center and reaches full intensity within 500ms.

tasks.title: Implement T+3000ms: Cartographer entity spawns (200 Gold splats forming humanoid shape)
tasks.deliverable: Cartographer entity composed of 200 Aged Gold Gaussian splats arranged in a humanoid silhouette that materializes at T+3000ms.
tasks.acceptance: At T+3000ms exactly 200 splats with color #B8860B form a recognizable humanoid shape that fully materializes within 1 second.

tasks.title: Implement T+4000ms: 60Hz ambient drone onset via Web Audio API oscillator
tasks.deliverable: Web Audio API oscillator generating a 60Hz ambient drone that begins at T+4000ms with smooth volume ramp-in.
tasks.acceptance: At T+4000ms a 60Hz sine wave oscillator starts and ramps from silence to target volume over 2 seconds without audio clicks or pops.

tasks.title: Implement T+5000ms: Fade complete (Cartographer stable, overlay fades to transparent)
tasks.deliverable: Final Descent state at T+5000ms where the overlay fades to transparent revealing the 3D scene with Cartographer visible.
tasks.acceptance: At T+5000ms the overlay opacity transitions to 0.0 over 1 second and the Cartographer entity is fully visible in the 3D scene.

tasks.title: Build timing controller orchestrating T+0 through T+5000ms with precise requestAnimationFrame scheduling
tasks.deliverable: Timing controller using requestAnimationFrame that fires Descent milestones at precise intervals from T+0 through T+5000ms.
tasks.acceptance: All five timing milestones fire within 16ms of their target timestamps as measured by performance.now() across 10 consecutive runs.

tasks.title: Create film grain post-processing shader with variable opacity (0 to 0.05 during Descent)
tasks.deliverable: Post-processing film grain shader with a uniform-controlled opacity parameter that ramps from 0 to 0.05 during the Descent sequence.
tasks.acceptance: Film grain is invisible at opacity 0 and subtly visible at opacity 0.05 with random noise pattern that changes every frame.

tasks.title: Build Cartographer as SparkJS dynamic splat cloud (200 splats, Gold #B8860B palette, subtle breathing motion)
tasks.deliverable: Cartographer entity implemented as a SparkJS dynamic splat cloud with 200 Gold-colored splats and continuous subtle breathing animation.
tasks.acceptance: Cartographer renders as 200 splats in Gold palette with visible breathing scale oscillation of 0.95-1.05 at 0.2Hz cycle rate.

tasks.title: Implement cathedral reverb convolution via Web Audio ConvolverNode
tasks.deliverable: Web Audio ConvolverNode loaded with cathedral impulse response that applies reverb to all Descent and calibration audio.
tasks.acceptance: Audio output exhibits a reverb tail of 2-4 seconds characteristic of cathedral acoustics when a test impulse is played.

tasks.title: Build audio volume ramp curve (GainNode 0 to 0.15 exponential ramp over 3 seconds)
tasks.deliverable: GainNode exponential ramp from 0 to 0.15 over 3 seconds for smooth non-jarring audio introduction during Descent.
tasks.acceptance: Audio gain follows an exponential curve from 0.0 to 0.15 over exactly 3 seconds with no audible clicks at ramp start or end.

tasks.title: Create silhouette prompt SVG overlay (Bone #F5F0E8, human outline at viewport center)
tasks.deliverable: SVG silhouette overlay showing a human outline in Bone white color positioned at viewport center for calibration alignment.
tasks.acceptance: SVG silhouette renders in #F5F0E8 at viewport center with proportions matching an average human upper body outline at arm's length.

tasks.title: Implement silhouette flicker shader (opacity oscillation 0.12-0.18 at irregular intervals)
tasks.deliverable: Shader effect on the silhouette overlay that creates organic flickering by oscillating opacity between 0.12 and 0.18 at non-uniform intervals.
tasks.acceptance: Silhouette opacity varies between 0.12 and 0.18 with interval randomization so no two consecutive flicker periods are the same duration.

tasks.title: Build alignment score function: compare face mesh landmarks to silhouette target positions
tasks.deliverable: Scoring function that computes a 0-1 alignment value by comparing key Face Mesh landmark positions against silhouette target coordinates.
tasks.acceptance: Perfectly aligned face returns score above 0.95 and face offset by 50% of viewport width returns score below 0.3.

tasks.title: Implement 3-second stillness hold timer (alignment above 0.85 sustained for 3s = calibration pass)
tasks.deliverable: Hold timer that requires alignment score to remain above 0.85 continuously for 3 seconds to trigger calibration completion.
tasks.acceptance: Timer completes and fires calibration-pass event only after alignment stays above 0.85 for a full 3 seconds without dipping below.

tasks.title: Build THOOM unlock transient audio (low-frequency percussion hit plus reverb tail)
tasks.deliverable: Low-frequency percussion transient audio (the THOOM) that plays on calibration completion with cathedral reverb tail.
tasks.acceptance: THOOM audio plays a sub-100Hz percussion hit with peak amplitude at 80Hz and reverb tail lasting 2-3 seconds on calibration success.

tasks.title: Create CalibrationState state machine: Waiting to Detecting to Aligning to Holding to Complete
tasks.deliverable: Finite state machine managing calibration flow through five ordered states with valid transitions and timeout handling.
tasks.acceptance: State machine transitions through all five states in order during successful calibration and handles timeout reset from any state to Waiting.

tasks.title: Implement calibration failure handler: 30s timeout triggers gentle silhouette pulse re-prompt
tasks.deliverable: Timeout handler that resets calibration after 30 seconds of failed alignment and triggers a gentle silhouette pulse to re-engage the user.
tasks.acceptance: After 30 seconds without successful calibration, state machine resets to Waiting and silhouette pulses at 0.5Hz for 3 cycles.

tasks.title: Build calibration success to vessel spawn transition (silhouette dissolves, splat vessel materializes)
tasks.deliverable: Transition sequence where the silhouette dissolves into particles while the user's splat vessel simultaneously materializes at the same position.
tasks.acceptance: Silhouette dissolves over 1 second while vessel splats materialize from edges inward, completing within 1.5 seconds total.

tasks.title: Implement calibration audio feedback (subtle tone at 0.5, 0.7, 0.8 alignment thresholds)
tasks.deliverable: Audio feedback system that plays subtle tonal cues when alignment score crosses 0.5, 0.7, and 0.8 threshold values.
tasks.acceptance: Distinct tonal cues play at exactly the 0.5, 0.7, and 0.8 alignment thresholds with each tone higher in pitch than the previous.

tasks.title: Build calibration timeout progressive prompting (15s: pulse faster, 25s: brighter, 30s: re-prompt)
tasks.deliverable: Progressive visual prompting system that increases silhouette urgency at 15s, 25s, and 30s timeout thresholds.
tasks.acceptance: At 15s silhouette pulse rate doubles, at 25s silhouette brightness increases by 50%, and at 30s the full re-prompt sequence triggers.

tasks.title: Create session persistence system in localStorage: ThresholdState with visit_count, calibration_complete, etc.
tasks.deliverable: localStorage-backed session persistence storing ThresholdState including visit count, calibration status, last visit timestamp, and session history.
tasks.acceptance: ThresholdState persists across page refreshes with all fields correctly serialized and deserialized including visit_count increment.

tasks.title: Build Return Protocol: compressed Descent on returning visit (2s instead of 5s)
tasks.deliverable: Compressed Descent sequence for returning users that runs the same milestones in 2 seconds instead of 5 seconds.
tasks.acceptance: Returning user Descent completes all visual milestones in 2 seconds total while first-time user Descent takes the full 5 seconds.

tasks.title: Implement re-calibration logic: require new calibration after 7+ days since last session
tasks.deliverable: Re-calibration trigger that checks last session timestamp and forces new calibration if more than 7 days have elapsed.
tasks.acceptance: Users returning within 7 days skip calibration while users returning after 7 days are routed through the full calibration flow.

tasks.title: Create Threshold Memory: session history as faint light traces on South zone floor
tasks.deliverable: Visual representation of past sessions as faint light traces rendered on the South zone floor, one trace per previous visit.
tasks.acceptance: Each past session renders as a distinct faint light trace on the South zone floor with older sessions appearing dimmer than recent ones.

tasks.title: Enforce anti-tutorial constraint: zero text instructions during entire Descent and Calibration
tasks.deliverable: QA verification that confirms zero text, labels, tooltips, or written instructions appear during the Descent and Calibration sequences.
tasks.acceptance: Manual and automated scan of all Descent and Calibration DOM elements confirms zero text nodes or aria-label text visible to the user.

tasks.title: Build loading screen for slow WebGL initialization (minimal, Deep Ink themed, no text)
tasks.deliverable: Minimal loading screen in Deep Ink color that displays during WebGL context initialization without any text elements.
tasks.acceptance: Loading screen renders in #1A1A2E with a subtle animated element and contains zero text characters, disappearing when WebGL is ready.

tasks.title: Implement vessel spawn animation (splats materialize from edges inward over 1.5s)
tasks.deliverable: Vessel materialization animation where splats appear starting from the silhouette edges and fill inward over 1.5 seconds.
tasks.acceptance: Splats visibly materialize from outer boundary toward center over exactly 1.5 seconds with smooth opacity ramp per splat.

tasks.title: Create session start timestamp tracking for visit duration
tasks.deliverable: Session start timestamp recorder that captures the exact moment of session initialization for visit duration calculation.
tasks.acceptance: Session start timestamp is recorded within 100ms of page load and accurately calculates visit duration on session end.

tasks.title: Build session close handler (beforeunload saves ThresholdState to localStorage)
tasks.deliverable: beforeunload event handler that persists the current ThresholdState to localStorage when the user closes or navigates away.
tasks.acceptance: ThresholdState is saved to localStorage on tab close and the saved data matches the runtime state at the moment of closing.

tasks.title: Implement visit counter increment on each new session start
tasks.deliverable: Visit counter that increments the ThresholdState visit_count by 1 each time a new session begins.
tasks.acceptance: After 5 consecutive page loads, ThresholdState.visit_count reads exactly 5 with each increment persisted to localStorage.

tasks.title: Build Path B calibration flow: skip silhouette, spawn geometric vessel, show navigation hint glow
tasks.deliverable: Alternative calibration flow for Path B users that skips silhouette alignment, spawns geometric vessel, and shows directional hint glow.
tasks.acceptance: Path B flow skips calibration silhouette, spawns icosahedron vessel within 500ms, and shows a forward-pointing glow hint toward North zone.

tasks.title: Create Cartographer idle animation: slow drift plus splat breathing (scale oscillation 0.95-1.05)
tasks.deliverable: Idle animation for the Cartographer entity combining gentle positional drift with splat scale oscillation between 0.95 and 1.05.
tasks.acceptance: Cartographer visibly drifts in a slow figure-eight pattern while splats oscillate scale between 0.95 and 1.05 at 0.15Hz.

tasks.title: Implement Cartographer attention tracking: faces vessel direction as user enters
tasks.deliverable: Attention tracking behavior where the Cartographer entity rotates to face the user vessel direction during the onboarding sequence.
tasks.acceptance: Cartographer forward vector points toward the vessel position within 5 degrees at all times during the calibration sequence.

tasks.title: Build Descent skip detection for dev mode (URL param ?skip-descent=true)
tasks.deliverable: URL parameter check that skips the entire Descent sequence when ?skip-descent=true is present for development purposes.
tasks.acceptance: Adding ?skip-descent=true to the URL bypasses all Descent timing and jumps directly to the calibration or exploration state.

tasks.title: Create audio mute/unmute toggle (minimal, respects user preference, persisted)
tasks.deliverable: Minimal audio mute toggle that persists user preference to localStorage and suspends/resumes the Web Audio context.
tasks.acceptance: Toggling mute silences all audio immediately and preference persists across page refreshes via localStorage.

tasks.title: Implement Descent replay capability (accessible from settings for returning users)
tasks.deliverable: Replay function that allows returning users to re-experience the full 5-second Descent sequence from a settings trigger.
tasks.acceptance: Triggering replay runs the complete 5-second Descent sequence with all visual and audio milestones identical to the first-run experience.

tasks.title: Build webcam permission denied flow: explain nothing textually, show Path B geometric vessel
tasks.deliverable: Permission-denied flow that transitions to Path B without any text explanation, relying on visual cues to guide the user.
tasks.acceptance: On webcam denial, Path B vessel appears within 1 second with zero text, labels, or written explanations shown to the user.

tasks.title: Create Cartographer navigation hint: drift toward North (Breathfield) after calibration
tasks.deliverable: Post-calibration behavior where the Cartographer slowly drifts toward the North zone as a non-verbal navigation hint.
tasks.acceptance: After calibration completes, Cartographer begins drifting toward North (0,0,-50) at 0.5 units/sec and reaches 10 units North within 20 seconds.

tasks.title: Implement calibration data capture: save alignment_score and hold_duration to session
tasks.deliverable: Data capture module that records peak alignment score and hold duration from the calibration process into the session state.
tasks.acceptance: After calibration, ThresholdState contains the peak alignment_score and total hold_duration values matching the calibration session metrics.

tasks.title: Build Descent performance monitor: track frame times during sequence
tasks.deliverable: Performance monitoring overlay that tracks and displays frame times throughout the Descent sequence for optimization analysis.
tasks.acceptance: Monitor captures per-frame timing data for all Descent frames and flags any frame exceeding 16.67ms in the debug overlay.

tasks.title: Create Calibration state persistence: resume if tab was closed during calibration
tasks.deliverable: State persistence that saves calibration progress to localStorage so users can resume calibration if the tab is accidentally closed.
tasks.acceptance: Closing the tab during Aligning state and reopening resumes calibration from the Aligning state rather than restarting from Waiting.

tasks.title: Implement Descent audio ducking: reduce music volume during calibration listening phase
tasks.deliverable: Audio ducking system that reduces the ambient drone volume by 50% when the calibration state machine enters the Aligning or Holding states.
tasks.acceptance: Drone volume drops to 50% within 200ms of entering Aligning state and returns to 100% within 200ms of calibration completion.

tasks.title: Build first-run detection: distinguish brand new user from returning user
tasks.deliverable: First-run detection function that checks localStorage for existing ThresholdState to distinguish new users from returning users.
tasks.acceptance: Function returns true for first-ever visit (no localStorage entry) and false for all subsequent visits after ThresholdState is created.

tasks.title: Create smooth transition from Descent to exploration (camera easing from Cartographer to vessel)
tasks.deliverable: Camera transition that smoothly eases from the Cartographer viewing position to behind-vessel third-person perspective over 2 seconds.
tasks.acceptance: Camera smoothly transitions using ease-in-out curve from Cartographer view to vessel follow-cam position in exactly 2 seconds.

tasks.title: Implement Descent accessibility: reduced motion mode skips animations, shows static states
tasks.deliverable: Reduced motion mode that respects prefers-reduced-motion media query by replacing animated Descent transitions with static state changes.
tasks.acceptance: With prefers-reduced-motion enabled, all Descent milestones show instantly without animation while maintaining the correct visual end states.

tasks.title: Build comprehensive Descent to Calibration to Vessel integration test
tasks.deliverable: End-to-end integration test covering the complete flow from Descent start through calibration completion to vessel spawn and exploration readiness.
tasks.acceptance: Test verifies all timing milestones, calibration state transitions, vessel spawn, and camera transition complete without errors in under 15 seconds.

tasks.title: Create Descent visual regression test (screenshot comparison at each timing milestone)
tasks.deliverable: Visual regression test suite that captures screenshots at each Descent timing milestone and compares against baseline reference images.
tasks.acceptance: Screenshots at T+0, T+1000, T+2000, T+3000, T+4000, and T+5000ms match baseline references within 2% pixel difference threshold.

tasks.title: Build onboarding Zustand slice: descentComplete, calibrationState, isReturningUser, vesselType
tasks.deliverable: Zustand store slice managing onboarding state including descent completion flag, calibration state, returning user flag, and vessel type selection.
tasks.acceptance: Onboarding slice correctly stores all four state properties with TypeScript types and selectors return memoized values without unnecessary re-renders.
